methodologyNotes: Products were selected from the target roster (Kalamera 24-inch 40-bottle French door, Kalamera KRC-46DZB, NewAir AWR-460DB, NewAir AB-1200, Wine Enthusiast Classic 80, Frigidaire FFWC3822QS, hOmeLabs 18-Bottle, hOmeLabs 43-Bottle, Antarctic Star 18-Bottle+66-Can, Ivation 28-Bottle, Avanti BCA5105SG-1, Vinotemp VT-51SZ01SS, Euhomy Eden Plus 15-Inch). The prompt's 'Vinotemp 53-Bottle' and 'Euhomy 15-Bottle' did not match any verifiable SKU; the closest verified Vinotemp is the 51-bottle VT-51SZ01SS and Euhomy's 15-inch line is the Eden Plus (listed as 30/33 bottles depending on listing). Specs sourced from manufacturer pages (newair.com, kalamera.com/shopify.kalamera.com, euhomy.com, vinotemp.com, ivationwinecoolers.com, antarctic-star.com, wineenthusiast.com), major retailers (Home Depot, Best Buy, AJ Madison, abt, Town Appliance), and third-party listings (atlaswinesales.com). Prices are published US MSRP or lowest current listed retail price independently re-verified on 2026-06-19. Where a price could only be sourced to a stale (2023-dated) third-party listing, priceUsd was set to null. Adversarial re-verification corrected two temperature ranges (Frigidaire, Wine Enthusiast) and nulled one stale price (hOmeLabs 18-bottle). All 13 products were confirmed to exist; none were fabricated. accessedAt 2026-06-19.
